why: The lasting version of Show: it writes the page into the keep list, and a fresh copy of the post - as after a reload, when nothing remembers the click - is not hidden. It used to be offered only on posts the shape rule hid, and the keep list only consulted by that rule, so a labelled post the user knew was wrong could not be kept at all.
